approval_required_for: Any change to decoder operator order, stage boundaries, pipeline topology, edge IDs, residual skip sources, branch/join fire rules, or token/tile/lane/word transfer order.

Any memory layout, DDR base-address, AXI width, runtime ABI, or board deployment change used to compensate for a pipeline_planning mismatch.
